findings: The regular curriculum totals 180 EC, includes the separate zero-credit requirements and uses a linked thesis specialisation. Year-one completion, author-focused study and 12 EC of earlier specialisation precede the thesis.

The closest option retains substantive philosophical courses and argument, with cultural and historical complements. Neurobiology, empirical psychology and machine learning are complementary rather than substitutes for philosophy of science.

The offered semesters resolve the three timing conflicts. Positive relationships distinguish philosophical subject matter and substantive interpretive methods.
